title: AI & Plant Operations Data Analyst
description:
About Rohan Chemicals
 
**Rohan Chemicals** 
 , built on the legacy of 
 **Rohan Dyes \& Intermediates Limited** 
 , is an Indian chemical manufacturing and export company with a legacy of more than three decades. The company manufactures and markets a diversified portfolio of 
 **sulphur\-based chemicals, specialty chemicals, dyes and dye intermediates** 
  for domestic and international markets.
 



 Our product portfolio includes 
 **Sulphuric Acid, Oleum, Chlorosulphonic Acid, Liquid Sulphur Dioxide (SO₂), Liquid Sulphur Trioxide (SO₃), Dimethyl Sulphate (DMS), dye intermediates and specialty dyestuffs** 
 , serving industries including agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, textiles, leather, paper and specialty chemicals.
 



 As we continue to expand our manufacturing capabilities, we are now focusing on building a 
 **data\-driven operating system for our manufacturing plants** 
 .
 



 We are looking for an ambitious individual who can help us use 
 **data, artificial intelligence and automation to improve plant productivity, reduce operating costs and make faster, better management decisions.** 



 About the Role
 
**Location:** 

  Corporate Office, Satellite, Ahmedabad, Gujarat
 




**Employment Type:** 

  Full\-time \| On\-site
 




**Department:** 

  Operations / Digital Transformation
 




**Reporting To:** 

  Senior Management / Plant Head
 



 We are looking for an 
 **AI \& Plant Operations Data Analyst** 
  who can convert the large amount of operational information generated every day in our plants into 
 **structured data, actionable intelligence and management decisions** 
 .
 
 A significant amount of plant information currently comes through 
 **WhatsApp messages, shift reports, production sheets, maintenance reports, laboratory reports, utility records and other Excel/data sheets** 
 .
 



 The core objective of this role is to bring all of this information together and answer:
 



**What happened?** 




**Why did it happen?** 




**What is the financial/operational impact?** 




**What action is required?** 




**Who is responsible?** 




**Has the action been completed?** 




**This is not a conventional MIS or data\-entry position** 
 .
 



 We are looking for someone who can use 
 **AI, data analytics and technology to identify inefficiencies and improve the actual performance of a chemical manufacturing plant.** 



 Key Responsibilities1\. Convert WhatsApp \& Plant Reports into Intelligence
 * Identify and consolidate operational information currently communicated through WhatsApp and other informal channels.
* Convert unstructured messages into structured operational data.
* Categorize information relating to production, maintenance, utilities, quality, breakdowns, manpower, energy and environmental performance.
* Use AI/NLP tools to extract important information automatically.
* Develop daily and weekly 
 **Plant Intelligence Reports** 
 .
* Identify recurring problems, abnormal events and operational trends.



 The objective is to move from 
 **"collecting reports" to "generating intelligence."** 



 2\. Improve Plant Energy Efficiency
 
 Analyze plant data to identify opportunities to reduce:
 


* Electricity consumption
* Steam consumption
* Fuel consumption
* Energy consumption per MT of production
* Compressed air and utility losses
* Equipment running losses
* Abnormal energy consumption



 The candidate should be able to identify questions such as:
 



**Why has energy consumption per MT increased?** 




**Which equipment or process is responsible?** 




**Where are we losing energy?** 




**What corrective action can reduce the cost?** 



 3\. Improve Manufacturing Efficiency
 
 Analyze production data to identify:
 


* Production efficiency
* Batch\-wise performance
* Production delays
* Downtime
* Process deviations
* Recurring operational problems
* Production losses
* Raw\-material consumption
* Yield variations



 The candidate will work closely with 
 **Production, Maintenance, Utilities, ETP and Plant Management teams** 
 .
 


 4\. Maintenance \& Breakdown Intelligence
 
 Create a structured system to track:
 


* Equipment breakdowns
* Downtime
* Maintenance requests
* Preventive maintenance
* Corrective actions
* Root\-cause analysis
* Spare\-parts requirements
* Repeated equipment failures
* Pending maintenance activities



 The system should clearly show:
 



**Issue → Responsible Person → Target Date → Action → Status → Closure** 




**Management should be able to immediately identify overdue and recurring problems** 
 .
 


 5\. Pollution \& Environmental Data
 
 Analyze operational and environmental data to identify opportunities to reduce:
 


* Pollution load
* SO₂/SO₃\-related emissions
* Acid mist
* Effluent load
* Waste generation
* Chemical losses
* Abnormal operating conditions



 The objective is to use data to identify 
 **the operating conditions that contribute to higher pollution and develop preventive actions.** 



 6\. Manpower \& Labour Productivity
 
 Analyze manpower deployment against production and plant requirements.
 



 Identify:
 


* Idle manpower
* Overtime
* Shift\-wise manpower utilization
* Repetitive manual activities
* Opportunities for automation
* Labour productivity
* Manpower requirements by activity/process



 The objective is to improve 
 **manpower utilization and operational productivity** 
 .
 


 Build a Digital Plant Monitoring Application
 
 A major part of this role will be to help develop a 
 **web\-based application for plant operations and issue management** 
 .
 



 The application should eventually allow plant personnel to enter and monitor:
 


* Daily production
* Shift production
* Raw\-material consumption
* Energy consumption
* Utility consumption
* Quality parameters
* Breakdown information
* Maintenance activities
* ETP/environmental parameters
* Manpower deployment
* Corrective actions



 The candidate may build the application directly using appropriate technologies and AI\-assisted development tools, or work with external developers to implement the system.
 


 Management Dashboard \& AI Reporting
 
 The ultimate objective is to create a management dashboard that can answer, at any time:
 


 Plant Performance
 * What was produced?
* What was the target?
* What was the variance?


 Energy
 * Energy consumption/MT?
* Is it improving or deteriorating?
* Where is the abnormal consumption?


 Maintenance
 * What broke down?
* How much production was lost?
* Which problems are recurring?
* What actions are overdue?


 Environment
 * Are pollution parameters within expected levels?
* What operational factors are affecting them?


 Management Actions
 * What are today's critical issues?
* Who is responsible?
* What is overdue?
* What requires management intervention?


 Skills \& Qualifications
 
 Candidates with experience or knowledge in some or all of the following will be preferred:
 


* Advanced Excel
* SQL
* Power BI / Tableau
* Data cleaning and analysis
* Dashboard development
* Python
* Artificial Intelligence / Generative AI
* AI agents and automation
* APIs and database integration
* Web application development
* Process automation
* Data visualization
* Business intelligence



 Experience in 
 **chemical manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, process industries, manufacturing or industrial operations** 
  will be an advantage.
 



 However, we are equally interested in candidates who may not have extensive manufacturing experience but demonstrate 
 **exceptional analytical ability, technology skills and the ability to understand real\-world business problems.** 



 What We Are Looking For
 
 We are 
 **not looking for someone who simply prepares reports and dashboards** 
 .
 



 We are looking for someone who can look at plant data and ask:
 


**Where are we losing money?** 
**Why is this happening?** 
**Can we predict it before it happens again?** 
**Can AI automate the monitoring and follow\-up?** 
**What action should management take?** 

 The successful candidate will have the opportunity to work directly with 
 **plant operations and senior management** 
  and build systems that have a measurable impact on the company's manufacturing operations.
 


 Success in this role will be measured by real business outcomes:
 * Lower energy cost per MT
* Lower production downtime
* Reduction in recurring breakdowns
* Better manpower utilization
* Reduction in pollution load
* Faster closure of plant issues
* Improved production efficiency
* Automation of manual reporting
* Better visibility and control for management



**If you are excited by the opportunity to combine AI, data and technology with real\-world chemical manufacturing, we would like to hear from you.** 




**Apply with your CV and a brief note explaining one manufacturing or business problem you would like to solve using data and AI.** 




**Rohan Chemicals** 




**Built on the legacy of Rohan Dyes \& Intermediates Limited** 




**Ahmedabad, Gujarat** 
 www.rohanchemicals.com

 is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.

 We are proud to be part of an ever\-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee\-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.

Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be
 **brilliant**

**Job Description:**
 Join Our Award\-Winning Team of Quantity Surveyor!
   

  

 Are you passionate about sustainability and cost data analysis? We are seeking a talented Quantity Surveyor to join our dynamic team. With opportunities across various markets, including Water, Environment, Energy, Rail, Highways, and Ports, we offer a diverse and exciting career path.
   

  

 Join our global team and work on international projects that significantly impact sustainability worldwide. Collaborate with experts from around the globe and gain valuable international experience. Be at the forefront of innovation in cost and carbon data analysis, utilizing cutting\-edge technology and advanced data analysis tools to drive sustainability and efficiency in our projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
 You will support our clients in capturing, validating and curating cost data at various project stages, including two\-stage award, and upon project completion. This will involve the reviewing of cost data provided by contractors as part of tender returns and final accounts against the clients Work Breakdown Structure, and validating that it has been correctly allocated, with appropriate tags (coverage rule criteria) and yardsticks (quantities and units of measurement) attributed.
   

  

 You will manage the data base of costs to ensure it remains fit for purpose, including normalising for inflation, and changes to asset standard changes. Additionally, you will support our teams in undertaking analysis’ to understand and predict trends, monitor performance and recommend efficiency improvements and risk mitigations.
   

* Analyse project data and technical drawings to extract relevant cost and carbon information.
* Allocate costs and apply yardsticks to various assets within projects.
* Develop and maintain databases for cost and carbon data capture.
* Collaborate with project managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to ensure accurate data collection and reporting.
* Prepare detailed reports and presentations on cost and carbon.
* Identify trends and insights to support decision\-making and project planning.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations related to cost and carbon reporting.
* Continuously improve data capture processes and methodologies.


**Qualifications, Skills, and Experience:**
**Essential:**
* Bachelor’s degree in quantity surveying, engineering or other construction discipline.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in data analysis tools and software (e.g., Excel, SQL, Python, PowerBI, R).
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with clients and colleagues.
* Ability to follow prescriptive processes.
* Work experience 8\-12 Years.


**Desirable:**
* Knowledge of industry standards and regulations related to cost and carbon reporting.
* Relevant experience in Water, Environment, or Transport sectors
* Sound knowledge in Cost and Contracts for infrastructure projects and programmes.
* Proven experience in data analysis, cost allocation, and carbon reporting.
* Experience using estimating systems, such as CCS Candy, Benchmark Estimating System or other.

 At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work\-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.

* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave

* Career mobility options

* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing

 Help Players Discover Great Games
   

  

 At GameGenesis, we're looking for an analytical and growth\-driven ASO (App Store Optimization) Intern to help improve the visibility and performance of our mobile games across app stores.
   

  

 You'll work on keyword research, competitor analysis, store listing optimization, conversion rate improvements, and app growth strategies that help our games reach more players.
   

  

 If you're passionate about mobile gaming, digital marketing, data analysis, and growth, we'd love to have you on our team.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 Your Mission
   

  

 \- Conduct keyword research and identify opportunities to improve app discoverability.
   

 \- Optimize app titles, subtitles, descriptions, and metadata for the Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
   

 \- Analyze competitor apps, rankings, keywords, and marketing strategies.
   

 \- Monitor app rankings, downloads, conversion rates, and performance metrics.
   

 \- Assist in A/B testing app icons, screenshots, videos, and store creatives.
   

 \- Research market trends and player behavior to identify growth opportunities.
   

 \- Prepare reports and insights based on ASO performance data.
   

 \- Collaborate with designers, developers, and marketing teams to improve store performance.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 We're Looking For Someone Who
   

  

 \- Has a strong interest in mobile gaming, ASO, and digital marketing.
   

 \- Possesses excellent research and analytical skills.
   

 \- Has good written communication and copywriting abilities.
   

 \- Understands basic SEO and keyword research concepts.
   

 \- Is comfortable working with spreadsheets, data, and performance metrics.
   

 \- Has strong attention to detail and problem\-solving skills.
   

 \- Is proactive, organized, and eager to learn.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 It'll Be Awesome If You Also Have
   

  

 \- Familiarity with Google Play Console and App Store Connect.
   

 \- Experience using ASO tools such as Sensor Tower, AppTweak, MobileAction, or App Radar.
   

 \- Knowledge of Google Analytics or Firebase Analytics.
   

 \- Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO).
   

 \- Experience with mobile app, gaming, or digital marketing projects.
   

 \- Basic understanding of app monetization and user acquisition.
   

 \- A portfolio, case study, or project demonstrating research or marketing skills.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 Why Join GameGenesis?
   

  

 \- 🎮 Work on real mobile game growth and optimization projects.
   

 \- 📈 Learn industry\-standard ASO and app growth strategies.
   

 \- 🚀 Gain hands\-on experience with app store optimization and analytics.
   

 \- 🤝 Collaborate with developers, designers, and marketers.
   

 \- 📂 Build a portfolio with real\-world mobile marketing projects.
   

 \- 🌍 Learn how successful games attract and retain players.
   

 \- 📈 Outstanding performers may be considered for future full\-time opportunities.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 Our Growth Toolkit
   

  

 Google Play Console • App Store Connect • Sensor Tower • AppTweak • MobileAction • Firebase Analytics • Google Analytics • Google Sheets • Canva

title: Yardi System Specialist - Multifamily
description:

 Relay Human Cloud is a young \& dynamic company that helps some of the top US\-based companies to expand their team internationally. Relay is a truly global company having its operations in US, India, Honduras, and Mexico (We are also adding a few more countries soon). Our core focus is to enable companies to connect with the best international talent. Relay helps its clients in majorly following areas: Accounting \& Finance, Administration, Operations, Space Planning, Leasing, Data Science, Data Search, Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence etc. Relay India operates from Ahmedabad and Vadodara offices. The principals and founders of Relay Human Cloud have been focused on delivering high\-quality operations in cutting\-edge companies for their entire careers.
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 We are seeking an experienced Yardi Administrator to manage and optimize our Yardi Voyager platform in support of our multifamily property portfolio. This role is responsible for system administration, data integrity, reporting, and ensuring the platform's associated modules run smoothly to support property management, accounting, and leasing operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Serve as the primary system administrator for Yardi Voyager, ensuring accurate configuration and ongoing maintenance
* Manage user access, roles, and permissions across the platform
* Maintain data integrity across property, unit, resident, and lease records
* Administer and support associated Yardi modules (e.g., RENTCafé, Yardi Procure to Pay, Payment Processing, Yardi Screening, Affordable Housing/LIHTC if applicable, Ancillary Services, CRM/Leasing)
* Build and maintain custom reports using Yardi Report Writer or similar tools
* Troubleshoot system issues and coordinate with Yardi support for escalations
* Support month\-end and year\-end close processes related to system data
* Assist with new property onboarding/setup and portfolio acquisitions or dispositions within the system
* Train property\-level staff on Yardi functionality and best practices
* Ensure compliance with company policies and industry regulations (fair housing, affordable housing requirements, etc., as applicable)
* Partner with accounting, operations, and leasing teams to streamline workflows within Yardi
* Stay current on Yardi updates, patches, and new module releases



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience administering Yardi Voyager in a
 **multifamily** 
 environment
* Demonstrated experience with associated Yardi modules (list specific modules relevant to your portfolio, e.g., RENTCafé, Yardi Procure to Pay, Yardi Screening, CRM/Leasing, Ancillary Services)
* Strong understanding of property management and accounting workflows (AR/AP, GL, budgeting)
* Experience building and customizing reports within Yardi
* Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Yardi certification(s)
* Experience supporting a multi\-property/multi\-entity portfolio
* Prior experience in a shared services, offshore, or centralized operations environment
* Familiarity with affordable housing/LIHTC compliance within Yardi (if applicable to portfolio)
